verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents a real automation path: the CKS API supports create/list/update/delete of clusters (coreweave-docs-5), Terraform/OpenTofu IaC for full infra management (coreweave-docs-6, coreweave-docs-28), API access tokens plus generated kubeconfig for kubectl-based workload execution (coreweave-docs-7, coreweave-docs-17), and node pool/autoscaling APIs for GPU provisioning (coreweave-docs-3, coreweave-docs-16). Billing/quota data can be exported programmatically via the FOCUS API for monitoring (coreweave-docs-34). However, evidence never shows a dedicated CoreWeave CLI or an MCP server/tool integration for agent-native control, and 'monitoring' beyond billing/quotas is largely described as a Cloud Console feature (coreweave-docs-12), so the loop isn't fully agent-drivable end to end without console fallback for some steps. missing for 10: a documented CLI or MCP server, and API-native workload monitoring/observability (vs. Console-based quota/usage views).
